contea di ritrovamento: County Durham (Inghilterra e Galles)
ANTONINVS AVG PIVS PP TR P [C]O[S III]

Complete worn Roman copper-alloy sestertius of Antoninus Pius (AD 138-161), minted at Rome, Reece 7. RIC III 626. Obv: Laureate head, facing right. Legend: ANTONINVS AVG PIVS PP TR P [C]O[S III]. Rev: Spes advancing left, holding flower and raising skirt. SC on either side. Lengend: none. Diameter: 32.8mm. Thickness: 3.4mm. Weight: 23.7g
